question: Which fleets the AI's naval regroup splits and merges in a new game's first hours.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits
addresses.comment:
**The theatre agent's fleets, every pass the tick allows.** Extent 0x4D0880-0x4D3EA1 (the throw tail past the real `ret 8` at 0x4D3E67). Gates: `!force && !at_war (+0xACC) && !in_undeclared_war (+0xACD)` returns; force clears +0x85; no fleet on +0xDC returns; the area is GetArea or the theatre of the unit's province, which must be ours. Phases in order: (1) 0x4D099D withdraw from a losing sea battle (slot-17 ratio against 0.5). (2) 0x4D0B30 **idle fleets home**: a fleet not moving, with no busy order (slot 24) and not at its own base is MoveUnit-ed to its base when CanUnitReach; but a fleet whose definition carries troops (transport_capability >= 1000) stays in port while the plan has an embark (CUnit +0x284); a fleet with no base or an unreachable one is kept on a 'homeless' vector. (3) 0x4D0D70 port and repair, and the 'ready' vector (FINDINGS-agents.md C.3). (4) 0x4D14F0 **existing orders**, per ready fleet: an idle fleet with no destination (+0x2CC) sitting in a port that is not its base is moved to its base, unless it holds a transport and lies in the plan's embark port; a busy fleet: join_fleet - the mover and its target go on the 'handled' list and the port tallies move; a busy transport fleet carrying nothing (CNavy +0x2EC) is cancelled unless CUnit +0x2CA is set; convoy_raid and convoy_escort are cancelled at peace, an escort also when its target is gone; patrol is kept only at war; any other order is kept while the fleet has a destination, cancelled at its own base, and an intercept with no destination away from base is cancelled; cancel = IssueUnitOrder(none) and MoveUnit to the base (or where it is). (5) 0x4D19F6 split and merge (C.3). (6) 0x4D2025 the handled fleets swap-removed from the ready vector (Vector_SwapRemoveValue, which reorders it); +0x27C and +0x280 zeroed; **enemy survey**: every naval unit of every country at war or in undeclared war with us within NavalDistanceTo 1000 of one of the theatre's ports and hostile where it stands (CCountry::IsEnemy) adds GetPower/1000 to +0x27C and goes on a local list, troop carriers (+0x2EC > 0) at the front, the rest at the back. (7) 0x4D2418 per ready fleet: submarine convoy raid, or relocation to the port with most raidable tonnage when fewer than half the route provinces seen are raid candidates, or a surface rebase; the tail adds a free fleet's GetPower/1000 to +0x280 and keeps it free (FINDINGS-airnaval4.md, and FINDINGS-moving.md D). (8) 0x4D323D **patrol**, with naval stance != 0 and (at war, undeclared war or +0x28C > 0): the region V = the +0x284 provinces, or failing any, the sea zone (+0xA4) of each theatre port, both less what CAIUnit_IsBalticBarredToAllies refuses; while V is not empty: centre = V[rand() % |V|] (the C runtime's rand, per thread), the patrol area the centre plus the nearest remaining V entries to it (up to five provinces, each swap-removed from V); the fleet = the nearest free fleet with no busy order, no submarine and at least one screen; `patrol` from now to now + 168 hours over that area; no fleet ends the phase. (9) 0x4D37EA **intercept**, per enemy fleet of the survey list at sea and not Baltic-barred, and only where enemy power (+0x27C) <= own power (+0x280) x 1.5 (2.0 at naval stance 1) unless it carries troops: need = its GetPower/1000, target = need (x 0.66 for a troop carrier); free fleets are gathered nearest first (NavalDistanceTo, strict, first of equals) while 2 x need > gathered, each reachable (CanUnitReach), of non-zero power, not on patrol unless the enemy carries troops, and with a screen when the enemy is all submarines; if gathered >= target, the first gets `intercept` on the enemy fleet and the rest `join_fleet` onto the first, each window now to now, own power reduced and need reduced by each until it falls below zero. Returns 'split or merged a fleet'; slot 73 ignores it.

**Read again 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 25). **After the split and merge, an unforced pass ends** (`cmp byte [ebp+0xC], 0` at 0x8D202B): the survey, the per-fleet raid and rebase, the patrol and the intercept run only when the pass is forced - the full pass or replan_naval - at war as at peace. Phase 4's raid, escort and patrol are kept when the country is at war **or in an undeclared war** (+0xACD), not at war alone: on the save of July 1941 the United States is in one, and its Pacific patrols are kept at peace for 48 hours. **Phase 7's tail, on the listing 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 42): only a fleet holding no transport (CountShipsByRole out[1] < 1, 0x4D3146) goes on - its power added to +0x280 unless its order is 0x6DE, 0x6E5 or 0x6E9, and it is put on the free list ([esp+0x154], 0x4D3222) where order slot 24 is clear or its order is 0x42E or 0x6E8; the patrol and the intercept take fleets only from that list, so a fleet carrying a transport is sent on neither. **The patrol's rand measured 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 53): drawn at 0x4D33E6 on the C runtime's per-thread stream - fresh worker threads from seed 1 (41, 18467, 6334), the main thread carrying on from every draw since the process began; entering July 1941 Germany, Britain, the Soviet Union and the United States drew on the main thread. **The split and merge read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 57): a fleet walked is passed over retreating, fighting, empty, handled, under a blocking order (0x4D1A9A) or away from its own base (0x4D1AA7); a fleet that split a ship off is pushed onto the handled vector at 0x4D1D29 and still looks for a partner; the merge asks fewer than 6 ships by the fleet's own count (+0x40, 0x4D1D45), the split ships not yet gone.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift
addresses.comment: **Which theatre area each land unit is bound for, and the plan's embark and debark.** Read whole on the listing, 0x4C4370 to the `ret 8` at 0x4C7530 (early `ret 8` at 0x4C43B4). One caller, CAIUnit::Tick at VA 0x8B0C38 (answer ignored), for the agent nearest above its unit, daily = (hour == (id+6)%24). Runs when the agent has a unit and (+0x5C is set - cleared here - or daily, or its CEU3AI does not run units). **Nothing at all unless the country owns at least one whole unit of transport capacity** (UnitList_SumTransportCapacity over CCountry +0xBAC >= 1). (1) Areas: the theatre's areas (+0x84) that are real, in order; per area need = EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, .., relaxed) with relaxed = at war and not COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(area), halved (C division) when relaxed and the area is the acting capital's; have = CountDivisionsInArea(.., false) (divisions by Unit_GetAnchorProvince(.,1): target if set, else destination or position). (2) Each unit of +0x11C with a target whose area is real and not one of the theatre's: kept only if army_role 0 and the target is held by a country we CanOperateIn; else target cleared (CArmy +0x2E8 = 0 at once and CSetAIParamCommand(unit, 0, staging) posted) and, a division, counted where it stands. (3) Each theatre area with have > need: repeatedly the division (+0x300 clear) bound there that stands in a theatre area of positive need and is farthest from its target - or, with an embark set, any standing outside embark's area (10000) before those inside it (distance to embark) - is released the same way, until have <= need. (4) Each unit: a target that CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea no longer allows is released; one it allows is listed for sealift (weight += definition weight/1000), counting it toward the embark tally when bound for debark and standing in embark's area. A unit with no target standing in our own land outside the theatre's areas (or trespassing anywhere outside) is 'stranded' - a trespasser whose path ends in a friend's land has its target zeroed and is not. (5) Deficit list: per theatre area need-have, our areas sorted largest first (stable; an equal at the head with more provinces goes first), others' areas sorted the same way then pushed in front one by one (so reversed). Per area: want = max(deficit, stranded count where the area is not an enemy's and (touches a hostile area, or is the theatre's largest area, or with no theatre is first)); with want >= 1 the target province is CAIUnit_PickLandingProvince for an enemy-held area, else CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives; then while want >= the next area's deficit (or the area is an enemy's and want > 0) the best unit gets it - CArmy +0x2E8 = province, CSetAIParamCommand(unit, province, staging) - marched with CEU3AI::MoveUnit(.., 0, 1, 1, 0) where CMapProvince::CanUnitReach(province, unit, 1, 1), else listed for sealift. Candidates: no target, anchor area real, CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea, not army_role 8 while the agent has air transports, not standing beside an enemy area that also touches the target area, not in a friend's land beside an enemy, own area not still needing it, the headquarters only to the largest area, a division; score = surplus of its own area (+10000 stranded; otherwise only while the deficit is >= 1), + slot 87 (enemy area) or slot 88 by the four touches-war cases (+x, +101-x), + 2 x slot 88 where the target area's +0x3C < 1, +100 where its parent is bound there and +50 per sibling bound there, x2 (CUnit +0x2C9 set) or x0.25 (standing on an ops-area province) where its own area borders an enemy; the strictly highest wins. (6) Every non-division of +0x14C with no target and not a theatre: target = CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives of the area most of its land children stand in, where that is not its own, posted with staging 0 and no move. (7) Tail: +0xD4 = sealift weight; +0x58 = COwnerArea_LargestNavalBase of the theatre's largest area (no theatre: of the unit's area), 0 with no weight. Embark/debark cleared (CSetPlanTransportStateCommand(unit, 0, 0)) when only one is set or both are and nobody bound for debark stands in embark's area. While debark is unset, weight > 0 and the agent has naval transports (+0xEC): votes per listed unit for its target - 1, or 4 where its area's need < 1, +3 where its area holds a played-country objective (never for the AI), +10 where the target is not ours - the strictly best untried target is debark, embark = CAIUnit_PickEmbarkPort of the area (not debark's) where most of the units bound there stand, the strictly largest that yields a port; posted, or the target set aside and the vote repeated. With both set: every listed unit bound for debark standing in embark's area, not aboard, fighting or retreating, adds its weight and is boarded where it stands at embark (0x4D4070) or marched there; transports at embark with no busy order count their transport_capability/1000; while weight > capacity, the transport not at embark, with no blocking order, CUnit::CanMoveTo(embark), organisation >= 0.01, with the lowest ((1-strength)+(1-org))*2+1 times sea distance/1000 is sent (MoveUnit 0,0,0,0); the first idle transport in embark's port then runs 0x4D4D40 or, failing it, 0x4D42D0. Answers whether it posted the pair or moved/boarded anyone. Ghidra's own label on it, CSetAIParamCommand::CSetAIParamCommand_4, is wrong. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section F. **Read again 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 43): logged live, it runs once after a load's second pass with +0x5C set (the constructor's seed). Step 4's embark tally compares embark's area (0x4C59B7) with the area of the unit's destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince, 0x4C5625), or of its province with none (0x4C5630) - stored at [esp+0x48], 0x4C5680 - not where it stands. **Live 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 50): a unit's sealift weight is its rebuilt definition's +0x10C, so a land brigade of no width under 1.000 organisation - CUnit::RebuildDefinition's reduced path - weighs nothing; Italy's 4a Armata, an hq_brigade at organisation 0 waiting at embark 10731 entering July 1941, counts 0 troops (logged at 0x4C71E3) and no transport is sent. **A transport fleet is sent by CEU3AI::MoveUnit(fleet, embark, 0, 0, 0, 0)** at 0x4C7396 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 57, read 2026-11-12) - before the tick's naval body, which then finds it bound.
